Definition: Nimrah, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Nimrah is a place east of the Jordan, named among the cities the tribes of Reuben and Gad ask for when they see the land is good for cattle. It is a name in the list of the request, nothing more.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the request list is honest geography: Nimrah is named because the tribes wanted its ground, and God gave it to them.
